data.completion_memo: Implemented an event-sourced one-Chat/one-Run lifecycle aggregate with legal start/input/attempt/wait/approval/pause/cancel/retry/fork/continuation and terminal transitions. Frozen snapshot identity is write-once. cargo test -p aworkit-trusted-core passes.
data.description: Implement the event-sourced one-Chat/one-Run lifecycle with legal commands and transitions for creation, first-input start, queued input, attempts, waits, approvals, pause, cancellation, retry, fork, continuation, and terminal inspection. Frozen workflow, binding, and authority identity must remain immutable after start.
data.title: M04.3 — Implement the Chat and Run lifecycle aggregate
